criteria.justification: Core platform scope is stated, but integration methods and capacity targets are deferred.
criteria.evidence: The proposal offers a configurable customer-service platform; CRM and ERP integration methods will be agreed during discovery.

criteria.justification: Named roles and milestones exist; acceptance and contingency need definition.
criteria.evidence: Delivery is planned over 14 weeks with discovery, configuration, migration, acceptance testing and a two-week hypercare period.

criteria.justification: A usable total estimate is present, with material exposure to extra integration days.
criteria.evidence: The estimated three-year total is USD 312,000; custom integration changes are charged at USD 1,200 per consultant day.

criteria.justification: Several concrete controls are described, but assurance and residency are unresolved.
criteria.evidence: The service supports SSO, encrypted storage, quarterly access reviews and a 90-day audit trail.

criteria.justification: Extensive relevant project history and specific escalation commitments.
criteria.evidence: Orbit reports 18 comparable fictional deployments and offers 24/7 critical response within 30 minutes, with named escalation owners.

risks: Integration architecture and effort are unresolved.
Commercial total may rise with discovery-driven changes.
Security assurance documents and data region need confirmation.
overall_summary: Strong comparable experience and support, but vague integration commitments weaken technical confidence and cost certainty.
